THE BIN MELTED AND MAY HAVE RELEASED AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF THE MATERIAL ONTO THE GROUND, BUT THAT HAS NOT BEEN CONFIRMED. Report Description
WEDNESDAY MORNING APPROXIMATELY 07:00 THERE WAS A VERY SEVERE RAIN STORM THAT PASSED THROUGH. IT LASTED WELL OVER AN HOUR. THERE WAS A PHONE CALL TAKEN FROM OUTSIDE SAYING THERE WAS SOME TYPE OF IMPRESSION ON THE WATER. THE COMPANY DISPATCHED ONE OF THE PRODUCTION OPERATORS TO THE SCENE. TWO OTHERS WERE ALSO DISPATCHED TO THE SCENE. IT APPEARS THERE MAY HAVE BEEN SOME RESIDUAL DIESEL FUEL IN A SKID PAN FROM AN AIR COMPRESSOR LOCATED IN THE SUSPECTED AREA OF THE IMPRESSION / ROSE BUD ON THE WATER. THE ROSE BUD WAS ESTIMATED TO BE 2 FT WIDE AND 12 FT LONG. SHORTLY AFTER THE ROSE BUD WAS SPOTTED, IT DISAPPEARED. OPERATIONS REPORTED DURING THE INVESTIGATION THAT THE WATER ISSUE WAS NOT FROM OUR PRODUCE WATER SYSTEM.

****WEB REPORT**** I WAS RECENTLY BURNED BY 121 DEGREE CELSIUS KH2PO4. MY EMPLOYER HAD NO POLICY IN PLACE TO DEAL WITH MY ACCIDENT. THIS CHEMICAL WAS RELEASED AND NOTHING IN PLACE TO CLEAN IT UP. THE HAZARDS ARE: AUTOCLAVES THAT ARE NOT OPERATIONAL, RESULTING IN ONE AUTOCLAVE BEING STUFFED FULL, WHICH RESULTED IN MY ACCIDENT. NO PPE NO PROCEDURES OR POLICIES THAT WE ARE INSTRUCTED ON, NO PROPER TRAINING. NO TRAINING OF EMPLOYEES REGARDING THE AUTOCLAVE, PPE, PROCEDURE IF A BURN OCCURS- NOBODY KNEW PROTOCOL RESULTING IN MY BURN DEVELOPING INTO A SECOND DEGREE BURN MANAGEMENT NOT KNOWING PROCEDURE FOR THESE OCCURANCES. MANAGEMENT NOW KNOWING WHAT TO DO WHEN SOMEONE IS INJURED, IT TOOK 3 DAYS TO GET WORKMAN'S COMP INFORMATION. HOOD IN MEDIA ROOM IS NOT OPERATIONAL, IT MAKES NOISE BUT DOES NOT EXHAUST FUMES RESULTING IN HEADACHE. UNSURE IF WASTE MANAGEMENT IS FOLLOWED- WE JUST THROW EVERYTHING IN MAINSTREAM GARBAGE. 10 PEOPLE WORK AT THIS FACILITY.

Suspected Responsible Party: EL PASO WATER UTILITIES
Skytruth Analysis
A 2000 LB CONTAINER OF CHLORINE USED IN THE WASTEWATER TREATMENT PROCESS WAS BEING CONNECTED TO THE CHLORINE SYSTEM. THE CONTAINER VALVE WAS OPENED AND THE CONTAINER EMPTIED ABOUT 2000 LBS INTO THE CHLORINE ROOM. THE CONTAINER IS LOCATED INSIDE AN ENCLOSED CHLORINE BUILDING EQUIPPED WITH A CHLORINE SCRUBBING SYSTEM AND ALARM. THE SCRUBBER WAS ACTIVATED BY THE CHLORINE RELEASE AND HAS BEEN RUNNING SINCE THE RELEASE OCCURRED. THE APPROXIMATE CONCENTRATION IN THE ROOM HAS BEEN DECREASING AND IS NOW ESTIMATED TO BE ABOUT 2 PPM. THE PLAN NOW IS TO ALLOW THE SCRUBBER TO CONTINUE RUNNING UNTIL THE CHLORINE CONCENTRATION IN THE ROOM IS COMPLETELY CLEARED.
